title: Witness shopping mandate (digital-product pilot)
description: Operator-signed, subject-bound spend authority for the narrow x402 digital-product pilot. No Shopify store URL, cart permalink, or merchant checkout URL is required or permitted. Validate this schema before signature verification. Caller-supplied public keys are never a trust anchor — the issuer pin is supplied independently.

schema.description: Domain version. An observation receipt or delivery attestation is not a mandate.

audience.description: This encoding is the x402 digital-product pilot only.

issuer_kid.description: Issuer key id. Not a public key. The verify pin is out of band.

subject.description: Bound agent or buyer subject. Compared to the actor that presents the mandate.

offer_id.description: Witness catalog offer id on the x402 rail (e.g. outbid-reader-scrape).

payee.description: Settlement destination the catalog vouches for. A display name is not identity.

product.description: Product or variant identity on the digital rail. Not a Shopify variant id.

currency.description: Pilot is USDC only. Fiat/card rails are the human-checkout path and out of scope.

max_total_minor.description: Cumulative ceiling in integer minor units (atomic USDC, 6 dp). One quoted call plus reserved spend must not exceed this.

expires_at.description: UTC expiry. Checked at Done evaluation, not at signing.

rail.description: merchant_checkout / merchant_hosted is the human rail and cannot satisfy this mandate.

resource_url.description: Optional https resource scope. Exact path or child path on the same origin. Not a storefront URL.

asset.description: Optional mint or contract the quote must still name.

terms_digest.description: sha256 hex of the license/terms bytes. A URL alone is not a commitment.

signature.description: Optional Ed25519 signature (base64) over the signing domain plus canonical body. Present after signMandate. Not sufficient for Done by itself.
